_comment: The DRESS REHEARSAL's initialize values (road step 8, SPEC items 22 and 53), for the throwaway program ids of the rehearsal tree ONLY. Status MAINNET: deliberately the ruled mainnet value. PROPOSED: a rehearsal choice awaiting Gary's approval. REHEARSAL-OPEN: a key or date made at rehearsal time, never before. REHEARSAL-NA: not used by the rehearsal. Judged by `node scripts/check-launch-params.mjs --rehearsal`; the mainnet check refuses this file outright.

init_authority.source: Gary 2026-10-08 (chat): "you sign the transactions". So the rehearsal deploys the `--features localnet` build, whose ONLY difference from the shipped build is INIT_AUTHORITY = this test key (seed 0x07 x 32; scripts/build-mainnet.sh proves both directions), and the box signs initialize. The seed is in our source, so a stranger who knew it could initialize first: deploy and initialize back to back, read every config back before any token moves, and if the read-back is not ours, close the programs (we hold the upgrade authority) and redeploy. Launch day's mainnet build still takes Gary's wallet in Phantom.

guardian.source: a throwaway on-curve key generated at rehearsal time into the rehearsal tree's .rehearsal-keys/guardian.json (600), so the box can exercise the brake; never Gary's wallet (the mainnet guardian)

bank_treasury.source: a throwaway on-curve key generated at rehearsal time into .rehearsal-keys/treasury.json (600): it receives the 15% and every rescue, so the rehearsal's cbBTC comes back to us. NEVER the CBOBTC Squads (rehearsal money and rescues would land in the real multisig)

payment_mint.source: real cbBTC: item 22.3 swaps real SOL into real cbBTC through the real Orca and Meteora pools, and the pages, alarm and crank name the real mints

reserve_mints.source: the real three (cbBTC, $GARY, $GIRAFFISH), in small amounts: the redeem page and the alarm pin these mints (bank/detectors.mjs RESERVE_MINTS), so throwaway mints would rehearse a different code path

pob_collection.source: a throwaway Core collection created at rehearsal time holding the rehearsal Proof of Burn assets. NEVER the real PoB collection: a charter claim BURNS the PoB it presents

vault_collection.source: created by the rehearsal's own step 10 (the ceremony page), update authority the rehearsal MINT's ["mint"] PDA, no plugins

pob_root.source: the Merkle root of the rehearsal PoB addresses, computed with scripts/pob-merkle.mjs rootOf at rehearsal time. NEVER the real 240-asset root

max_supply.source: Gary 2026-10-08 (chat) approved the rehearsal timings, census, swap bot and real-token amounts. five vaults: enough for 3 charter claims and 2 sold vaults, and the census can be EXHAUSTED for a few dollars (MINT requires only max_supply > 0, programs/cbob-vault-mint/src/lib.rs:582)

level_caps.source: Gary 2026-10-08 (chat) approved the rehearsal timings, census, swap bot and real-token amounts. one vault per level, so every level is drawn once and the census exhausts; each cap must be non-zero and the sum at most max_supply (programs/cbob-vault-mint/src/lib.rs:606-607)

charter_secs.source: Gary 2026-10-08 (chat) approved the rehearsal timings, census, swap bot and real-token amounts. a 30-minute charter window (mainnet 7 days); MINT allows 1 s to 90 days (programs/cbob-vault-mint/src/lib.rs:612-613, MAX_CHARTER_SECS :491)

charter_opens_at.source: a few minutes after the rehearsal's initialize, in unix seconds; the window must close in the future at initialize (programs/cbob-vault-mint/src/lib.rs:614)

monthly_secs.source: Gary 2026-10-08 (chat) approved the rehearsal timings, census, swap bot and real-token amounts. a distribution every 10 minutes (mainnet 30 days), so the crank's distribute and claim passes run many times in one sitting; MINT allows 60 s to 30 days (programs/cbob-vault-mint/src/lib.rs:617, MIN_MONTHLY_SECS :349)

notice_secs.source: Gary 2026-10-08 (chat) approved the rehearsal timings, census, swap bot and real-token amounts. 2-minute notice on a guardian or swap-operator change (mainnet 7 days); MINT allows 60 s to 30 days (programs/cbob-vault-mint/src/lib.rs:587, :509-510)

sweep_floor_lamports.source: Gary 2026-10-08 (chat) approved the rehearsal timings, census, swap bot and real-token amounts. 0.1 SOL, the lowest a tighten vote may set the cap; MINT requires 0.1 SOL to the cap (programs/cbob-vault-mint/src/lib.rs:590, :516)

cooldown_ceiling_secs.source: Gary 2026-10-08 (chat) approved the rehearsal timings, census, swap bot and real-token amounts. 2 hours: at least the cooldown and at most 7 days (programs/cbob-vault-mint/src/lib.rs:592, :493)

reserve_ceiling_lamports.source: Gary 2026-10-08 (chat) approved the rehearsal timings, census, swap bot and real-token amounts. 0.01 SOL: at least the reserve and rent (890,880) and at most 10 SOL (programs/cbob-vault-mint/src/lib.rs:594-595, :517, :523)

sol_reserve_lamports.source: Gary 2026-10-08 (chat) approved the rehearsal timings, census, swap bot and real-token amounts. 0.001 SOL kept in the revenue address, the smallest legal non-zero value above rent (programs/cbob-vault-mint/src/lib.rs:600); a 0.1 SOL top-up then sweeps about 0.099 SOL

max_sweep_lamports.source: Gary 2026-10-08 (chat) approved the rehearsal timings, census, swap bot and real-token amounts. 5 SOL per sweep: MINT requires 1 to 50 SOL (programs/cbob-vault-mint/src/lib.rs:596, :499-501), and the alarm reports a cap under 5 SOL as sweep_cap_wedged; the rehearsal's real sweeps are about 0.1 SOL each

sweep_cooldown_secs.source: Gary 2026-10-08 (chat) approved the rehearsal timings, census, swap bot and real-token amounts. 1 hour between sweeps, the alarm's minimum (bank/detectors.mjs sweep_cooldown_too_short is CRITICAL below 3,600 s); MINT allows 1 s to 24 h (programs/cbob-vault-mint/src/lib.rs:598). The three revenue cycles take about two hours

swap_operator.source: a throwaway on-curve hot key generated at rehearsal time into .rehearsal-keys/swap-operator.json (600). NEVER the ruled mainnet operator bipP7uK5aQDsrChYA8hpZ1Thb8BCw7emRGuEkLkHg6G

redeem_window_secs.source: Gary 2026-10-08 (chat) approved the rehearsal timings, census, swap bot and real-token amounts. one opening per minute at this supply (mainnet 1 hour); BURN allows 10 s to 24 h (programs/cbob-vault-burn/src/lib.rs:198, :161-162)

quorum_bps.source: the ruled 21%, so the rehearsal's votes are judged exactly as launch's will be; GOV allows 500-10,000 (programs/cbob-vault-gov/src/lib.rs:278, :231)

threshold_bps.source: the ruled 51%; GOV allows above 5,000 to 7,500 (programs/cbob-vault-gov/src/lib.rs:281, :236)

min_voting_secs.source: Gary 2026-10-08 (chat) approved the rehearsal timings, census, swap bot and real-token amounts. 2-minute votes (mainnet 3 days), so a sale round can be voted, opened and sold out in one sitting; GOV allows 60 s to 30 days (programs/cbob-vault-gov/src/lib.rs:282, :226, :237)

lock_deadline.source: Gary 2026-10-08: never final ("that's important as that's $900+"). the rehearsal programs are NEVER made final: closing them afterwards recovers about 9.2 SOL of program rent, which --final would forfeit. The alarm runs with CBOB_ALARM_REHEARSAL=1, which turns the lock checks off (SPEC item 53)

cbob_mint.source: a throwaway SPL mint created at rehearsal time (MINT requires an initialized SPL mint that is neither the payment mint nor $GARY, programs/cbob-vault-mint/src/lib.rs:570-578). NEVER the real $CBOB: a boost burns it

cbob_release_wallet.source: the throwaway key holding the rehearsal $CBOB supply, generated into .rehearsal-keys/cbob-release.json (600). NEVER the real release wallet
